prompt: One gold answer-containing sentence, two unrelated natural-language distractor sentences, a natural question, and an answer-only instruction.
structural_filter: The gold answer is one tokenizer token, maps to exactly one gold-context token with the same id, and the complete prompt is at most 256 tokens.
split_isolation: Structurally eligible examples are shuffled with seed 300000 + seed and partitioned into disjoint pilot, calibration, and evaluation sets before any intervention.
competence_gate: Pilot distractor-context exact next-token accuracy is at least 0.50, exceeds no-context accuracy by at least 0.10, and is no more than 0.05 above gold-only accuracy.
selection: Use the frozen source-mass and first-order utility-gain rules with four heads in one layer.
primary_estimand: Utility-selected source-max minus displacement-matched distractor-control output-margin effect on held-out evaluation examples.
success_rule: At least two seeds pass the untouched competence gate; the hierarchical 95% interval for the primary estimand is positive; and the utility-gain mean effect exceeds source-mass selection.
multi_evidence_trigger: Run the multi-evidence natural-language extension only if this single-evidence gate passes.

feasibility_amendment.timing: After an eight-example smoke test returned zero accuracy in main, gold-only, and no-context conditions; before any confirmatory seed was run.
feasibility_amendment.change: Render the same locked user prompt with the model tokenizer's official chat template and score a one-token answer at the assistant generation position. The answer source remains a separately identified one-token context span and need not share the output token id.
feasibility_amendment.reason: The plain-text prompt tested instruction-format compliance instead of context-grounded answer competence. No thresholds, data splits, selectors, interventions, or success rules changed.

assistant_boundary_amendment.timing: After backend parity debugging and before any confirmatory natural-QA run passed the competence gate.
assistant_boundary_amendment.change: Score a lowercase one-token gold answer in its deterministic sentence-initial form at the assistant generation boundary (for example, three becomes Three). Preserve already-capitalized and nonalphabetic answers. Require both the original context span and the scored answer form to be one tokenizer token.
assistant_boundary_amendment.reason: The official chat-template pilot showed sentence-initial capitalization while preserving the correct answer semantics. A single deterministic target keeps exact next-token margins and avoids a post-hoc set-valued acceptance rule. No data split, gate threshold, selector, intervention, or success criterion changed.
